svg.title: One Vectoree endpoint, four slug choices
svg.desc: A server sends one project key to https://vectoree.ai/api/v1. GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6.2 Astra, Luna, and vectoree/auto are slug choices. Search prints the slug. An empty search stays on vectoree/auto. OpenAI API ids are not the Vectoree slug.
